title: SuperPipeline decision.reminded and decision.escalated
description: A waiting decision passed its stage's timeout (charter: unanswered decisions remind, then escalate §2-3). Each is sent at most once per wait: remindedAt rides on decision.reminded, escalatedAt on decision.escalated. Mirrors SuperPipeline's DecisionNoticeBody (apps/api/src/board/decision-timeouts.ts). Readers ignore properties they do not know.

boardId.description: Null only on a board not yet initialised; a carrier needs it to route the event.

boardName.description: Empty string when the board has no name, never absent.

decisionId.description: The gate id (gate, delivery), the elicitation id (question), the wait id (attention) or the check set's arrival id (checks).
